checks: Upgrade archives old data and refuses anonymous legacy or global journal access
Real AES-256-GCM and Windows DPAPI round-trip a private account object
Lost object acknowledgements retry idempotently without allowing overwrite
Changing a nonce, GCM tag or ciphertext is rejected even after valid DPAPI rewrapping
The GCM identity binds both the account owner and the immutable object identifier
The profile keeps three distinct backups and rejects conflicting commits
Corrupt profiles restore a verified backup while sharing violations remain visible errors
If every profile copy is damaged the host refuses an empty reset or overwrite
A large Unicode journal restores backups and never falsely acknowledges a rolled-back serial
Collection removes orphan objects and preserves every referenced object and account journal
Closing the native vault invalidates its capability and exposes backup recovery status
The remembered vault key is DPAPI-protected and contains no password or bearer token
A complete Windows host restart restores the saved key, private objects and last journal
A locked saved-login file reports an error and never falsely acknowledges logout
A corrupt saved-login cache cannot erase private data and can be repaired by a valid owner
Explicit logout remains forgotten after another complete Windows restart
